title: SYNTHETIC: Files renamed with .lockd extension on file server
description: SYNTHETIC. Analyst report: users report they cannot open documents on file server FS-02. Hundreds of files in \\FS-02\shared\finance were renamed with the extension .lockd and a file README_RESTORE.txt appeared in each folder demanding payment. The Windows event log on FS-02 shows 'vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet' executed at 02:13 by account svc-backup. The originating workstation is not yet known.

attributes.note: SYNTHETIC test data created for CADE development. Not a real incident.
